note: Each site is a cell-sized recharge basin carved to its local pooled depth with the soil opened to Ksat; the reported m³ is measured by re-simulation and metered by per-cell soil capacity (metered=false means the bundle predates the aquifer and numbers are an upper bound). reduction_pct = share of the storm's would-be runoff ON LAND (permanent water excluded) sent underground. Sites sit on pervious ground only, buffered away from buildings. Costs use an indicative percolation-structure rate — relative ROI, not a bid.
